attributes.board_name: New York State Board for Psychology (NYSED Office of the Professions)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Formal continuing education from psychology CE providers approved by the State Education Department (courses taken on or after January 1, 2021)
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required during the initial three-year registration period (also for licensees previously practicing in another jurisdiction).
rules.audit_note: Keep records of completed continuing education for six years.

topics.who: All licensees: professional ethics, including New York practice laws, rules and regulations

rules.notes: 36 hours per triennial registration period; shorter periods prorated at 1 hour per month. Self-study max 12 hours per 3-year period (one-third otherwise); live interactive online courses are not self-study. Requirement started Jan 1, 2021.
